hypotheses.claim: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 under a 25 ms per-instance budget, a static merge score normalized by the global depot scale, score = (d(0,i)+d(0,j)-lam*d(i,j)+mu*|d(0,i)-d(0,j)|)/scale + w*((q_i+q_j)/Q)... , with lam in [0.8,1.6], mu small, and a dimensionless capacity-fill reward, will reach lower total tour length than plain Clarke-Wright static savings; because the static template stays ~2-3 ms, the residual budget can be spent on deterministic intra-route 2-opt, giving a further measurable reduction (expected ~1-3%) without any budget-exhaustion degradation.

next_search_advice.direction: Scale-invariant generalized savings merge score plus dimensionless capacity-fill bonus, then intra-route 2-opt polish within the 25 ms budget.
